prose: Archeo-Astronomer & linguistic code-breaker John McHugh returns to InnerVerse for our yearly Christmas special! Tune in to learn about the Celestial Code of Scripture that underlies all miracle stories of religion and mythology, and how the miraculous "Star of Bethlehem" of Jesus' nativity in the book of Matthew is exposed as the Royal Star Regulus, in the Leo Constellation. Wordplay within sacred writings reveals the "secrets of the gods," and with the information in this episode, you'll be privy to the archaic astral cipher, to better understand the basis for divine revelation.
